jobs.description:
The Opportunity
State Street Alpha’s End-to-End Product Solutions organization is seeking an Assistant Vice President of Product Strategy, Governance & Reporting Enablement to strengthen how Alpha plans, governs, reports, and communicates its product strategy.
This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who thrives at the intersection of product management, data, technology, and execution. You will own Alpha’s product roadmap and release-note processes, support Service Catalog governance, develop executive and client-facing materials, and build automated reporting solutions that connect product strategy, investment, delivery, and client value.

About the Team
This role sits within the Product Strategy, Planning & Enablement group and works closely with senior leadership across Product, Technology, Finance, Sales, Global Delivery, Alpha Data Services, and Charles River Development.

Key Responsibilities
As AVP of Product Strategy, Governance & Reporting Enablement, you will help provide the structure, data, and reporting required to manage Alpha’s end-to-end product portfolio:
Own the Alpha product roadmap
- Lead the quarterly collection, validation, and publication of product roadmaps across Alpha service families
- Maintain internal, executive, sales, and client-facing roadmap views
- Coordinate roadmap content across Alpha Services, Alpha Data Services, and Charles River Development

Lead roadmap and reporting automation
- Develop scalable Power BI, Jira, Excel, SharePoint, and Power Platform solutions
- Connect strategic initiatives to product features, funding, delivery milestones, applications, and client demand
- Improve data quality, reporting consistency, and historical tracking
- Replace manual presentation and reporting processes with governed, repeatable workflows

Manage release notes and product communications
- Lead the quarterly Alpha release-note process
- Reconcile roadmap commitments against completed delivery
- Convert technical releases into concise client and business-impact narratives
- Coordinate leadership review, publication, and organization-wide distribution

Support product investment and financial analysis
- Analyze business cases, product features, capabilities, estimates, approved funding, and impacted applications
- Build reporting at the business-case, feature, service-family, client, and application levels
- Support annual planning, budget scenarios, funding prioritization, and product P&L analysis
- Partner with Finance and product leadership to improve investment visibility and decision-making
- Lead product P&L analysis; develop and refine methodologies for allocating product revenue, expenses, and investment across Alpha service families

Support Service Catalog governance
- Coordinate governance meetings, agendas, materials, decisions, and action items
- Review catalog changes with product owners and cross-functional stakeholders
- Maintain clear standards for service capabilities, offerings, and supporting documentation
- Improve transparency and auditability through structured governance workflows

Develop executive and client-facing materials
- Prepare materials for executive meetings, QBRs, Client Advisory Boards, product offsites, and client presentations
- Distill complex product, financial, and technical information into clear executive narratives
- Create polished visualizations, dashboards, and decision-support materials

- Coordinate initiatives across Product, Technology, Finance, Sales, Global Delivery, and Client Solutions
- Organize product forums, town halls, offsites, and strategic planning sessions
- Document processes and build sustainable operating models
- Reduce manual effort while improving reporting speed, accuracy, and usability
- Track decisions, owners, dependencies, and action items through completion
- Coach and coordinate analysts and junior team members supporting reporting and automation

What We’re Looking For
- Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, finance, technology, information systems, or equivalent experience
- Experience in product operations, business analysis, portfolio reporting, governance, or financial-services technology
- Strong ability to translate complex product and financial data into compelling executive and client narratives
- Proficiency with Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, data modeling, and dashboard development
- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
- Experience with Jira, Jira Analytics, Jira Product Discovery, Confluence, Power BI, including dashboard development.  SharePoint, other Microsoft 365 tools and Co-pilot suite
- Understanding of product roadmaps, development lifecycles, funding processes, and governance
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
- Strong attention to detail and ability to reconcile information across multiple systems
- Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed environment
- Experience in investment servicing, asset-management technology, or front-to-back financial platforms is preferred
- Familiarity with State Street Alpha, Alpha Services, Alpha Data Platform, or Charles River

Product Manager – Observability (Dynatrace & AI)

Who are we looking for:

We are looking for a strategic Product Manager to own and evolve our observability product portfolio, leveraging Dynatrace SaaS, Business Events, and AI-driven insights from Davis. This role will define the vision, roadmap, and success metrics for observability across infrastructure and applications, ensuring alignment with business priorities. The Product Manager will partner with engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver a best-in-class monitoring experience that drives reliability, performance, and automation.

This role is critical to both Charles River Development and State Street because observability underpins the reliability, performance, and scalability of their investment management platforms. Charles River’s IMS platform and State Street Alpha® deliver front-to-back solutions for global asset managers, handling trillions in assets and servicing thousands of investment professionals. Ensuring these platforms remain stable and performant is essential for client trust and operational excellence. A dedicated Product Manager for Observability will define the strategy for proactive monitoring, predictive analytics, and automated remediation using Dynatrace and Davis AI, enabling faster incident resolution, reducing downtime, and improving client experience. This role aligns with State Street’s mission to innovate and maintain leadership in financial services technology by integrating advanced observability practices into cloud-based solutions, safeguarding critical business processes and supporting the firm’s global scale

Define Product Strategy & Roadmap:
- Establish the long-term vision for observability and monitoring capabilities using Dynatrace and related AI solutions.

- Define KPIs, SLAs, and baseline thresholds for monitoring performance.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement:
- Drive automation and integration initiatives to streamline monitoring processes.
- Explore AI-driven capabilities (e.g., Dynatrace AI) to enhance predictive insights and proactive remediation.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

- Familiarity with Davis AI and AI-driven observability solutions.
- Proven ability to define KPIs, SLAs, and monitoring strategies.
- Experience with cloud environments (Azure) and enterprise monitoring frameworks.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills.

Desired Qualifications:

- Knowledge of Dynatrace-ServiceNow integration.
- Familiarity with automation, DevOps, CI/CD, and IaC tools (Terraform, Jenkins, Git, Ansible).

The Markets FX Product Management team encompasses all aspects of the business: strategy implementation; design, development and implementation of client-facing products, trading infrastructure, geographic expansions and operating models; risk oversight metrics and reporting.

You will work directly with Sales, Trading and eFX teams across more than 10 sites globally, and partner with Technology, Operations, Finance, Risk, Legal and other business partners to execute initiatives from concept to production, and deliver products and infrastructure aligned with our strategic priorities.

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets. When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to our Markets business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, State Street Markets’ number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world.

This role is ideal for an experienced product, strategy, or digital-transformation professional with a strong understanding of institutional financial services, asset servicing, cash and liquidity management, and emerging digital technologies. The successful candidate will help shape and deliver Fund Connect’s strategy for providing institutional clients with access to both traditional and tokenized investment products through a unified platform.

The Vice President will   work   closely with senior leaders and partners across Product, Technology, Operations, Sales, Relationship Management, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and other State Street businesses. The role will also engage with asset managers, transfer agents, digital custodians, wallet providers, blockchain networks, fintech firms, and other external market participants.

The ideal candidate will combine   hands-on   product management experience, strong commercial judgment, and a practical understanding of blockchain, tokenization, digital wallets, digital cash, and tokenized investment products. Experience with traditional asset-servicing products and operating models, including money market funds, transfer agency, custody, cash management, collateral management, or fund administration, is highly desirable.

Why This Role Is Important to Us

Fund Connect is expanding its capabilities to support the convergence of traditional finance and digital markets. Our vision is to provide clients with a unified solution for managing digital and traditional short-term investments.

This position will play a pivotal role in advancing Fund Connect’s digital-asset strategy and translating emerging technologies into scalable, controlled, and commercially viable client solutions. The role will initially focus on tokenized money market funds and related digital infrastructure, while helping establish a foundation that can support the broader tokenization of real-world assets.

The Vice President will contribute to the development of solutions involving:

- Tokenized money market funds and other tokenized investment products

- Digital representations of real-world assets

- Institutional digital wallets and custody solutions

- Public and private blockchain connectivity

- Digital transfer agency and tokenization services

- Stablecoins and tokenized deposits

- On-chain settlement and transaction reporting

- Tokenized assets used for collateral and liquidity management

- Digital capabilities for Fund Connect’s white-label clients

- Integration of digital and traditional investment workflows

This is an opportunity to help define the next generation of institutional fund distribution, liquidity management, and digital-asset infrastructure.

What You Will Be Responsible For   Strategy and Execution

As Vice President, you will:

- Support the continued development and execution of Fund Connect’s digital-asset and tokenization strategy.

- Translate the strategy into a prioritized product roadmap, delivery plan, and measurable business outcomes.

- Identify opportunities for Fund Connect to support the issuance, distribution, trading, settlement, custody, and reporting of tokenized real-world assets.

- Conduct market, client, regulatory, and competitive analysis to inform product direction and investment decisions.

- Develop strategic recommendations for senior management regarding new digital products, partnerships, and market opportunities.

- Promote a coordinated, enterprise-wide approach by working across relevant State Street businesses and functional areas.

- Monitor developments in tokenization, blockchain infrastructure, digital custody, digital cash, decentralized finance, and institutional adoption.

- Define product requirements, use cases, workflows, client journeys, and operating models for tokenized products.

- Partner with Product Development, Technology, Architecture, Operations, and external providers to define and deliver product capabilities.

- Develop solutions that allow clients to access traditional and tokenized investments through an integrated Fund Connect experience.

- Support integration with tokenized fund providers, transfer agents, digital asset platforms, wallet providers, custodians, and blockchain infrastructure.

- Define requirements for digital order routing, transaction processing, settlement, position reporting, wallet connectivity, and client servicing.

- Coordinate product testing, operational readiness, implementation, and post-launch reviews.

- Maintain product documentation, decision logs, business requirements, workflow diagrams, and implementation materials.

- Ensure that solutions are scalable, resilient, interoperable, and aligned with Fund Connect’s broader product architecture.

Tokenization and Real-World Asset Solutions

- Lead the definition of Fund Connect use cases involving the tokenization of real-world assets.

- Develop institutional workflows for subscribing to, redeeming, transferring, settling, and reporting tokenized fund interests.

- Evaluate digital-native issuance models and digital-twin models representing existing financial assets.

- Explore opportunities to expand Fund Connect’s capabilities beyond tokenized money market funds into other appropriate tokenized securities and investment products.

- Assess how tokenized assets may support corporate treasury, investment, liquidity, and collateral-management use cases.

- Partner with internal teams to evaluate the use of tokenized deposits, stablecoins, or other approved forms of digital cash for settlement.

- Help define the role of digital wallets, custody services, digital transfer agents, smart contracts, and public or permissioned blockchains within the Fund Connect ecosystem.

- Support the development of controls for the movement of tokenized assets between clients, providers, custodians, and approved networks.

Client and Stakeholder Engagement

- Partner with Sales, Relationship Management, and senior product leaders during client discussions and product demonstrations.

- Explain complex digital-asset concepts in clear, practical, and commercially relevant language.

- Prepare client-ready materials, product presentations, workflow diagrams, and strategic proposals.

- Lead discovery sessions with asset managers, treasury organizations, white-label clients, and other institutional market participants.

- Provide clear product updates and recommendations to senior management and governance forums.

- Establish strong working relationships across multiple regions, businesses, and functional disciplines.

Commercialization and Business Management

- Assess client demand, addressable opportunities, implementation requirements, and potential commercial models.

- Support pricing, financial analysis, revenue planning, and go-to-market activity.

- Evaluate build, buy, or partner options for required digital capabilities.

- Conduct due diligence on external technology providers, custody providers, wallet providers, blockchain networks, and other strategic partners.

- Partner with Sales and Relationship Management to identify pilot clients and commercialization opportunities.

- Define product adoption measures and track progress against agreed business objectives.

- Support development of the long-term operating and support model for Fund Connect’s digital products.

Risk, Regulatory, and Governance
